name: Terenthis
summary: In Auberdine, Terenthis tracks corruption spreading into Darkshore. The Cenarion Circle sent the night elf druid from Teldrassil to learn how far it has reached and seek help from travelers and local allies.

sections.title: Investigating the Taint
sections.body: Terenthis searches Darkshore for Fel Moss and other signs of corruption. The Cenarion Circle sent him to Auberdine to follow the blight spreading from Teldrassil. Night elves fear it may break the balance of northern Kalimdor. He seeks the rot's cause and a way to stop it before it consumes the forests.

sections.title: A Plea from Grimclaw
sections.body: Grimclaw reaches Auberdine wounded and alone, seeking Terenthis's help. Terenthis recognizes that the bear's master, Volcor, is in grave trouble. Bound to his post, Terenthis sends travelers into the wilderness to find Volcor. Aggressive furbolg tribes have pinned the druid down after an ambush.

faq.answer: Terenthis serves the Cenarion Circle as a night elf druid stationed in Auberdine, Darkshore.
The Cenarion Circle sent Terenthis to Auberdine to investigate Fel Moss and magical corruption spreading from Teldrassil into Darkshore. He seeks a way to stop it.

faq.q: What is the bear beside Terenthis doing there?
aliases: why is there a bear in auberdine
faq.answer: Grimclaw came to Terenthis in Auberdine wounded and alone. His master, the druid Volcor, was ambushed and pinned down by aggressive furbolgs.

faq.q: What organization does Terenthis belong to?
faq.answer: Terenthis belongs to the Cenarion Circle, a druidic order that works to preserve balance and protect nature across Kalimdor.

faq.q: What threats is Terenthis most concerned with?
faq.answer: Terenthis fears Fel Moss corruption and the growing hostility of furbolg tribes, which threaten travelers and druids.

faq.q: Does Terenthis offer any tasks to adventurers?
faq.answer: Yes. Terenthis sends travelers to gauge threats along the coast, aid local allies, and help Volcor.

angles.text: As a druid of the Cenarion Circle, you stand with Terenthis against corruption spreading from Teldrassil into the mainland.
As a night elf, you share Terenthis's concern for purifying your sacred lands of fel taint and protecting innocent forest life.
